verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's product page publishes capacity (96 GB) and memory type (GDDR7), and community posts independently confirm 96 GB GDDR7. The evidence does not show memory bus width or memory bandwidth figures; the only bandwidth claim is about PCIe Gen 5, which is host-interface rather than VRAM bandwidth. Missing for 10: published memory bus width, published memory bandwidth (GB/s) for this exact part.
